messages:
IncidentBot: [ALERT] high error budget burn: gateway.5xx_rate (us-east) breached threshold. auto-created incident. link: https://dash.redwood/prod/gateway/errors

Diego M. (oncall): acknowledging. seeing huge spike in 5xx and gateway timeouts. starting triage. @Yara can you fetch cache-front metrics and recent deploys?

Yara S.: pulling metrics now. KV prefix cache miss ratio jumped at 1745554200. eviction events exploded on cache-node-07..09. memory pressure + oom-kill flaps on some pods.

Priya N.: grep of cache logs shows repeated "prefix index checksum fail" and then immediate tombstone write -> triggers eviction. sample:```
[2025-03-12T03:12:21Z] cache-node-08 ERROR prefix=org:beta-pay checksum=0x7c3a expected=0x4d11 action=mark_tombstone
[2025-03-12T03:12:21Z] cache-node-08 WARN eviction_reaper reclaimed=5300 duration_ms=1200
```

Theo R.: customer impact: PartnerPay (payments) reporting ~50% request failures on /v1/generate since ~03:12Z. Support ticket created and SEs looped in.

Diego M. (oncall): immediate mitigation idea: disable prefix cache lookups for top 100 hot prefixes to avoid rebuild churn, and route those prefixes to the cold-read path. applying canary to us-east-1a.

OpsBot: route change queued. executing: `redwoodctl routes apply --region us-east --filter 'prefix in hot_list' --set cache=disabled --mode canary`

Yara S.: canary applied at 1745554383 to routers in us-east-1a. monitoring events.

Priya N.: quick patch built for cache service: v3.0.4-hotfix disables aggressive tombstone promotion and skips checksum mismatch causing eviction. pushing to canary daemonset. Docker tag: cache:v3.0.4-hotfix.

Diego M. (oncall): rolling the canary patch to 10% nodes. will observe for 10m, then ramp. informing CS: "we've applied a mitigation, routing change, and a cache hotfix; working on full remediation".

Theo R.: initial canary results: PartnerPay 5xx down from 50% -> 12% in canary region within 2m. latency improved. beginning region-wide rollout.

Yara S.: also throttling background prefetch to reduce eviction pressure: `sysctl set cache.prefetch.window=2s` on affected nodes.

Priya N.: logs after hotfix show fewer checksum errors and less eviction churn. still seeing elevated misses on a couple shards - those will require rolling restart to clear possible corrupted state.

Diego M. (oncall): scheduling rolling restart of cache-node-07..09 with graceful drain and pre-warm disabled to avoid re-triggering churn. plan: 1 node at a time, wait until healthy, then continue.

OpsBot: rolling restart started at 1745554550 for cache-node-07. estimated completion 10m per node.

Theo R.: customer comms: PartnerPay SE updated at 1745554568 — mitigation applied, impact reduced, expected full recovery after restarts.

Yara S.: health snapshot (post-mitigation, pre-restarts):
- gateway 5xx (us-east): 42% -> 6%
- PartnerPay 5xx: 50% -> 8%
- affected shard miss rate: 82% -> 18%
- eviction events per minute: 4800 -> 200

Priya N.: action items for post-incident: (1) investigate root cause of checksum regression in prefix index builder; (2) add safety to avoid tombstone-promote-on-mismatch; (3) implement read-only fallback when checksum inconsistent.

Diego M. (oncall): incident severity downgraded to S2. handing off to night oncall @Theo. please continue rolling restarts and run integrity sweep on prefix indexes. create postmortem and schedule with eng-runtime + storage. ticket: https://tickets.redwood/INC-5822

Theo R.: taking over. summary for handoff:
- start: 1745554200, cause: cache prefix checksum mismatch + eviction storm -> gateway 5xx/timeouts
- mitigations: canary route bypass for hot prefixes, cache:v3.0.4-hotfix, throttle prefetch, rolling restarts
- customer impact: PartnerPay high error rate briefly; SEs updated
- remaining work: complete restarts, integrity sweep, postmortem

IncidentBot: incident transitioned to "mitigated" at 1745554698 (automated).

Theo R.: added follow-up: schedule full index verification job tonight at 2300 UTC and coordinate with storage team to snapshot affected shards before any heavy repair. attaching logs and dashboard in ticket. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
